key_idea: Convert both times to minutes within the week, take the difference modulo 10080 with 0 mapped to a full week, and format.
sketch: Split the difference into days, hours, minutes, drop zero components, pluralise when the value exceeds 1, and join one/two/three parts as 'a', 'a and b', 'a, b, c'. Pitfalls: identical times give '7 days', end before start wraps around the week, and the two-part form uses 'and' with no comma.
